name: WarpsMorph
description: Cross-mod morph in the spirit of Mutable Warps. One axis walks diode ring, XOR, comparator, mini-vocoder, and wavefolder. Y sets the internal carrier and harshness. Touch blends in the internal oscillator.

params.name: ALGO
params.detail: Morph: RING → XOR → CMP → VOC → FOLD

params.name: CARR
params.detail: Internal carrier mix when the pad is up
